name: Yuanlin City

queries.query: Yuanlin City Taiwan official cadastral parcel map GIS land registration service
queries.result: Official-source discovery found the National Land Surveying and Mapping Center (NLSC) public cadastral viewer/WFS documentation and the official Yuanlin Land Office. The bounded anonymous cadastral feature request was denied and the viewer exact-point overlay returned no land-number result; no parcel geometry was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official NLSC cadastral service and Changhua County Yuanlin Land Office local cadastral administration.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: NLSC cadastral layer and schema were verified, but anonymous feature access was denied and the exact-point viewer request returned no land-number result; citywide open geometry coverage is unknown.

technicalBlocker: The official NLSC WFS schema is public, but the bounded anonymous GetFeature request returned Permission Denied. The viewer overlay request returned a no-land-number message and exposed no polygon response.
remainingUncertainty: Current access controls, parcel query route, stable native identity semantics, update currency, CRS of any future feature response, and citywide coverage remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted. A zero exact-point response or access denial is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
pointBasis: Exact unchanged WUP 2025 settlement point (latitude, longitude); not shifted to force a parcel hit.
